“His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you…
Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the…
Blessed are those servants, whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will…
Truly I tell you, that he will set him over all that he has.
“He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have…
I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,
that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”
If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will…
If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father…
He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

parallels.note: Truly I tell you, that he will set him over all that he has.

translations.web: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
translations.bsb: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
translations.kjv: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
translations.asv: Verily I say unto you, that he will set him over all that he hath.
